items.title: Kroger Under Pressure as Shoppers Become More Price-Sensitive
items.summary: The Kroger Co. (NYSE:KR) cut its full-year 2026 identical-sales forecast excluding fuel to 0.2%–0.8% from 1%–2%, reflecting a sharper-than-expected slowdown in consumer demand. Second-quarter identical sales rose just 0.2%, down from 3.4% a year earlier and below the 0.9% analyst estimate. items.title: Kroger trims 2026 sales outlook despite profit gains
items.summary: Quarterly operating profit rose to $971m from $863m, while net earnings attributable to Kroger increased to $641m from $609m.

items.title: KR Q2 Deep Dive: Margin Gains and Strategy Focus Amid Flat Same-Store Sales
items.summary: Grocery retail giant Kroger (NYSE:KR) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 2% year on year to $34.62 billion. Its GAAP profit of $1.05 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.
